tools.name: peerlytics_paid_datasets
tools.description: List the paid Peer datasets with coverage, columns, prices and x402 download URLs. Free.

tools.name: peerlytics_weekly_seller_rates
tools.description: Weekly realised seller premiums against the ECB reference for one currency across platforms, or one platform route, for every ISO week since the first Base fill. Withheld weeks keep only the reason. Costs $0.05 in USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: peerlytics_liquidity_depth
tools.description: Hourly public USDC liquidity for one payment platform and currency: listed depth, sellers, best premium, largest order and depth within 0.5% to 3% of mid-market, for up to the last 168 recorded hours. Costs $0.05 in USDC on Base via x402.
